objects.description: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) compromised third-party infrastructure in physical proximity to targets of interest for follow-on activities.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
objects.description_fa: در طول [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051)، [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) زیرساخت های شخص ثالث در نزدیکی فیزیکی به اهداف مورد علاقه برای فعالیت های بعدی به خطر افتاد.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
